title: Ergodic Control and Controlled Diffusion for Robot Learning: Review and Tutorial
abstract: arXiv:2609.13295v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion learning leverages the statistical mechanism of diffusion processes for learning, reasoning, and inferring complex distributions from data. Recent advances in diffusion learning have been transformative, with robot learning emerging as a key opportunity area, with applications spanning perception, control, and decision-making. At the same time, the statistical mechanism of diffusion processes can be controlled to shape the temporal evolution of the state distribution underlying robot trajectories, inducing ergodic behavior in robotic systems. The frameworks of controlled diffusion and ergodic control were developed around the same time as diffusion learning, and their theories and algorithms have increasingly converged. translated_title: 遍历控制与受控扩散在机器人学习中的应用：综述与教程
translated_abstract: 扩散学习利用扩散过程的统计机制，从数据中学习、推理并推断复杂分布。扩散学习的最新进展具有变革性意义，机器人学习成为其中的关键机遇领域，应用涵盖感知、控制与决策。与此同时，扩散过程的统计机制可以被加以控制，以塑造机器人轨迹背后状态分布的时间演化，从而在机器人系统中诱发遍历行为。受控扩散与遍历控制这两个框架与扩散学习大约在同一时期发展起来，其理论与算法正日益趋同。由受控扩散诱发的遍历性对机器人学习具有若干重要意义，这与简单地将扩散学习应用于机器人问题有所不同：它以形式化方式强制执行统计特性……
tldr: 本文是一篇综述与教程，系统梳理了遍历控制与受控扩散两大框架及其与扩散学习的融合，阐明受控扩散诱发的遍历性能够为机器人学习形式化地保证轨迹对状态分布的统计覆盖特性。
en_tdlr: This review and tutorial systematically presents the ergodic control and controlled diffusion frameworks and their convergence with diffusion learning, demonstrating how controlled diffusion-induced ergodicity formally enforces statistical coverage properties of trajectories over state distributions for robot learning.
